CVE-2026-100290.assessment: The GNU C Library has a release-branch fix for POSIX regex allocation failure. The installed APK's exact build recipe has not been traced to that fix. The offline process reads repository-supplied content, so network isolation alone cannot resolve this match.

CVE-2026-115819.assessment: The GNU C Library has a release-branch fix for wide scanf. The installed APK's exact build recipe has not been traced to that fix.

CVE-2026-121758.assessment: The hash-locked r23 APK's embedded recipe identifies the glibc release-branch fix. The installed library and package SBOM must match the reviewed APK.

CVE-2026-124024.assessment: Wolfi removes the affected IBM1390 and IBM1399 modules in its build recipe. Require the exact image to omit both the optional glibc iconv package and both shared objects.

CVE-2026-103995.assessment: The scanner's container network denial limits exposure to remote HTTP responses. No verified fix is recorded for this CPython package.

CVE-2026-115559.assessment: The scanner has no remote IMAP connectivity. The provider still reports the exact CPython package as affected.

CVE-2026-115791.assessment: The scanner invokes no CPython archive extraction CLI on repository content. The fix appears in the next 3.15 changelog and is not verified in this package.

CVE-2026-124249.assessment: The scanner cannot contact remote cookie issuers. The provider still reports the exact CPython package as affected.

CVE-2026-16052.assessment: The scanner exposes no network HTTP cookie endpoint. A fix is not verified in the installed CPython package.

CVE-2026-19552.assessment: The scanner cannot retrieve remote TLS certificates. The provider still reports the exact CPython package as affected.
